name: YNExpandableCell
summary: Easiest way to expand and collapse cell for iOS with Swift 6
description: Easiest usage of expandable & collapsible cell for iOS, written in Swift 6. You can customize expandable `UITableViewCell` whatever you like. `YNExpandableCell` is made because `insertRows(at:with:)` and `deleteRows(at:with:)` are hard to use. You can just inherit `YNTableViewDelegate` and add one more method `func tableView(_ tableView: YNTableView, expandCellAt indexPath) -> UITableViewCell?`.
